purpose: Determine whether an existing verified answer, evidence bundle, legal analysis or official source can safely be reused for a new property question without conflating properties, dates, legal issues or source versions.
core_principle: FIND EXISTING KNOWLEDGE → CHECK IDENTITY/SCOPE/FRESHNESS → REUSE ONLY WHAT REMAINS VALID → RETRIEVE NEW EVIDENCE WHERE REQUIRED
rules: Same legal question does not imply same property evidence.
Same property does not imply same date or legal issue.
A general legal proposition may be reusable while property-specific facts are not.
A procedure can be reused only after currentness/access checks.
Historical legal analysis may be reused only when its temporal scope matches or remains applicable.
Verified evidence may be reused only when source identity, property identity, date scope and currentness requirements remain satisfied.
A reused component retains its provenance and original verification context.
Reuse never bypasses the current investigation quality gate.
hard_stops: Never copy a property-specific conclusion from one property to another.
Never reuse current evidence as historical evidence without temporal verification.
Never reuse stale procedure or deadline information as current.
Never merge different legal questions merely because wording is similar.
Never treat semantic search similarity as proof of equivalence.
Never bypass property/date matching because an existing answer looks relevant.
